tempoqueue — Rate-limited work queues

Source code: Lib/tempoqueue.py

This module provides a queue that releases items no faster than a configured rate, which is handy when calling a remote service with a request quota. It is built on top of queue, and it is safe to use from several threads at once.

Items are released in the order they were added, unless a priority is given. The rate is enforced with a token bucket, so short bursts are allowed as long as the average stays below the limit.

The module defines the following class:

class tempoqueue.TempoQueue(rate, burst=1)¶

Create a queue that releases at most rate items per second, with bursts of up to burst items. Both values must be positive, or ValueError is raised.

Rate presets¶

The following presets are available as module constants:

Constant

Rate

Burst

GENTLE

1 per second

1

STEADY

10 per second

5

EAGER

100 per second

50

Example¶

>>> import tempoqueue
>>> q = tempoqueue.TempoQueue(rate=2)
>>> q.put('job-1')
